name: IM K–12 Math (Illustrative Mathematics)
summary: A full K-12 math curriculum (K-5, 6-8, and high school Algebra 1, Geometry and Algebra 2), free to view online.

license.note: Two editions: IM K–12 Math (2019–2021, on im.kendallhunt.com) is CC BY 4.0 for any use; IM K–12 Math v.360 (2024, on accessim.org) is CC BY-NC 4.0, and commercial use needs a license from IM. Trademarks are excluded.

access_note: Free to view online at im.kendallhunt.com and accessim.org.
cite: Based on IM® K–12 Math by Illustrative Mathematics®, CC BY 4.0 (IM's attribution statement; v.360 has its own).

fits.how: Its lessons and practice problems could be an activity's readings and questions; the CC BY edition also for commercial use.
